content: Self-hosted country-from-IP without third-party API calls at request time: geoip-lite and geoip-country npm packages bundle MaxMind GeoLite2-derived data directly in the package/on-disk DB, giving fully offline, no-network-call country lookups suitable for a self-hosted app with no third-party tracking dependency at runtime (data snapshot ages between package updates, acceptable tradeoff for this use case).
